products.name: Decagon
products.note: Customer support agent platform; omnichannel; model-agnostic; Watchtower monitoring

profile_text.body:
Decagon is an AI company that builds and operates a customer support agent platform marketed as an AI concierge service for enterprise brands. The company describes itself as enabling businesses to build, optimize, and scale AI agents that deliver personalized experiences across the full customer lifecycle, going beyond what it characterizes as traditional support.

The core product, also called Decagon, is an omnichannel, model-agnostic platform for deploying customer-facing AI agents. It includes a monitoring layer called Watchtower and offers tooling for testing, observability, and experimentation, intended to help organizations validate and iterate on AI logic as their deployments evolve.

No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for this company.
